purpose: Provide machine-readable provenance from peer message(s) to coordinated work, execution, fetched source, observation, CAUSAL_ACK and state change without collapsing Scout identity or promoting routing context to evidence.

origin_semantics.single_origin_message_proven: Exactly one preserved origin message belongs to the completed work route.
origin_semantics.multi_origin_complete_trace: The work route is complete, but multiple preserved messages contributed the same coordinated task; no unique message cause is asserted.
origin_semantics.exact_workflow_trigger_claimed: True only for a COMPLETE_TRACE with exactly one preserved origin message.

interpretation.COMPLETE_TRACE: The workflow provenance chain identifies one coordinated peer-origin work route that produced a fetched source cited by the observation.
interpretation.AMBIGUOUS_MULTI_WORK_TRACE: Two or more distinct work routes can explain the observation, so no exact work route is claimed.
interpretation.UNATTRIBUTED_OBSERVATION: The observation remains preserved, but no exact peer-origin work route is demonstrated.

state_change.record_when: A fact first appears for that Scout after the peer-directed round.
